jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee – Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for experts to join an advisory committee, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks established specialists/activists with regional expertise, not a recent graduate, and reads as a voluntary/advisory position with no vacancy for the candidate. The human-rights and securitisation subject is a strong interest match, but the level and nature of the position are a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: IATF Lead Auditor
jobs.reason: Ineligible: this is a "Lead" role requiring a mandatory Certified IATF 16949 Lead Auditor qualification and proven substantial experience conducting third-party audits, none of which the candidate holds. The automotive quality-assurance field is also entirely outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: IMS Auditor
jobs.reason: Requires a registered IRCA (or equivalent) Lead Auditor qualification, substantial third-party ISO auditing experience, and at least two years managing environmental/safety compliance — essentials the candidate does not meet. It is also an environmental/safety compliance auditing role wholly outside the candidate's research and policy profile and interest zones.

jobs.title: Policy Research Intern
jobs.reason: This is an internship, which is excluded by policy, and it additionally requires excellent written and verbal Chinese as an essential — a language the candidate does not have. The academic-publishing focus is only tangentially interesting.

jobs.title: Director, Regulatory Solutions Business Analyst
jobs.reason: Director-level title requiring deep subject-matter expertise in global financial regulation and substantial senior experience — well beyond entry-level and a hard mismatch. The role also demands specialised financial-regulatory and strong data-science/coding skills the candidate does not possess, and it sits outside the core interest zones.

jobs.title: Client Support Advisor - kaufmännischer Mitarbeiter
jobs.reason: The role explicitly requires "many years of experience" in a client-facing/customer support role plus proven experience managing complex service delivery and ERP/CRM systems like SAP — an experience level the candidate does not meet. It is also a commercial client-support/administrative position wholly outside the candidate's research, policy and intelligence interest zones.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.reason: This is a deep-technical AI engineering role whose essential requirements — building LLM solutions, fine-tuning foundation models, writing production-quality Python, and solid ML theory — are well beyond the candidate's analysis-level Python and non-ML skill set. It is a genuine software/ML engineering position, not a research or policy role, and falls on the wrong side of the candidate's technical limits.

jobs.title: Senior Researcher - A Healthy Life
jobs.reason: The "Senior Researcher" level and pay band signal a role beyond entry-level, and the essential requirements centre on end-to-end statistical modelling and Python/R analysis of large datasets plus project/programme management — a substantial skills gap against the candidate's analysis-level, SPSS-oriented quantitative background. The health-innovation topic also sits outside the core interest zones.

jobs.title: Copy of Associate Consultant, Financial Communications - TMT
jobs.reason: The role is genuinely entry-level (six months to three years) and the required research, analytical and writing skills transfer from the candidate's RA and policy work, so it is a realistic application. However, it sits squarely in financial communications / investor relations — outside all three interest zones — and the candidate has limited dedicated comms and capital-markets exposure, which holds the priority down despite Teneo being an on-target firm for its geopolitical arm rather than this financial-PR team.
jobs.salary: Competitive salary (depending on experience); 28 days holiday, discretionary bonus, pension

jobs.title: Global Head, Health & Society, Research & Analytics (Thought Leadership)
jobs.reason: This is a "Global Head" leadership role requiring senior subject-matter expertise, leading a team of Principals and Content Leads, and years of editorial and commercial strategy experience — far beyond entry-level and a clear hard disqualifier on seniority. The health-economics focus is also outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - EXTEND
jobs.reason: This is a deep-technical software-engineering role whose essential criteria — production TypeScript/React/Node.js, testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines and TDD — are well beyond the candidate's analysis-level Python. It is also restricted to the BBC Extend programme for disabled applicants, and lies outside all core interest zones.

jobs.title: Associate or Senior Editor (Materials science and inorganic materials chemistry), Nature Communications
jobs.reason: Requires a PhD in inorganic materials chemistry or materials science as an essential — a qualification and technical field the candidate does not hold and is entirely outside their expertise. Both the discipline and the doctoral requirement are hard mismatches.
jobs.location: Shanghai, Beijing, Nanjing, Pune or New Delhi (hybrid)

jobs.title: Finance Analyst Iberia & WE
jobs.reason: Requires fluency in Spanish as an essential, which the candidate does not have, and it also asks for 2–5 years of finance/accounting experience plus GAAP/IFRS and ERP knowledge the candidate lacks. This is a specialist finance role well outside the candidate's research/policy profile and interest zones.

jobs.title: REACH Regulatory Manager
jobs.reason: Manager-level role requiring proven experience managing complex programmes and a scientific degree in chemistry/toxicology/environmental science — both essential requirements the candidate does not meet. The subject (chemicals regulatory compliance) is also outside all three interest zones.

jobs.title: Senior Change Manager
jobs.reason: Disqualified on level and qualification: it is a "Senior" role requiring a formal change-management certification (Prosci/APMG/CMI) and having led at least five significant change programmes — none of which the candidate has. It also sits entirely outside the candidate's research/policy interest zones.
jobs.location: London (also Salford, Cardiff, Bristol, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Newcastle, Birmingham) – Hybrid

jobs.title: Post-doctoral Research Associate
jobs.reason: The essential Criteria 1 requires an already-completed PhD in infrastructure studies, data science or a related field, which the candidate does not hold. It also requires data-science methods (web scraping, database creation, visualisation) beyond the candidate's analysis-level Python, so the qualification and technical requirements are both unmet essentials.

jobs.title: Associate Director/Director, Business Relationship Management (BRM) Financial Institutions, EMEA
jobs.reason: The title is Associate Director/Director — a senior, non-entry-level role requiring an established track record in debt capital markets, corporate finance or ratings, which the candidate lacks. It is also a business-development/sales function outside the candidate's research and policy focus.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.reason: The role is entry-to-junior project/grant coordination at a peacebuilding NGO, and the candidate's project-administration and funding-allocation experience (German Rectors' Conference, €1.7m) plus research background fit well; it is London-based, so it passes the location filter. Conflict prevention and peacebuilding is a strong interest match (zone a), though the emphasis is on grant administration and compliance rather than research, which tempers the score.

jobs.title: Deputy Security Operations Manager
jobs.reason: This is a Manager-level operational security role requiring extensive experience at security team-leader level, staff management, physical security surveys, crime scene management and an annual physical restraint assessment — none of which the candidate has, and the "Manager" level itself is a hard disqualifier. It is also entirely outside the candidate's research/policy interest zones.
jobs.salary: £36,513 to £41,565 pa (progressing to £44,468) inclusive of London allowance

jobs.title: Senior Quality Analyst
jobs.reason: This is a senior software-QA role requiring experience leading a QA strategy across a team of 5+ people, plus knowledge of cloud architecture, microservices and testing infrastructure — a senior technical position the candidate's analysis-level background cannot meet. Both the "Senior" level and the essential software-engineering requirements are hard disqualifiers.

jobs.title: Policy Fellow in Sustainable Structural Transformation
jobs.reason: This is a Grade 7 Fellow post requiring "a proven track-record of policy work in government, think tanks, policy-focused research centres" — a level of established professional experience the candidate, with only student-assistant/RA work, plainly lacks. It also sits outside the candidate's core zones, centring on development economics, industrial policy, energy transition and value chains rather than international law, atrocity prevention or European security.
jobs.location: Bloomsbury, Camden, Greater London, United Kingdom
jobs.salary: £43,297.57 to £50,562.57 per annum inclusive of London Allowance

jobs.title: Senior Lecturer (AC.07.4)
jobs.reason: Requires an already-completed PhD in Art History plus a Senior Lecturer-level teaching, supervision and research profile — both essentials the candidate lacks. The art-history / curatorial field is also outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Group Tax Analyst
jobs.reason: Eligible on a technicality — it is early-career and asks only for a related degree, but it wants a background in accounting, finance or tax and progress toward an ACA/ACCA/CTA qualification that the candidate lacks, making paper fit weak. Corporate tax compliance sits entirely outside the candidate's research, international-law and geopolitical-risk interest zones.

jobs.title: Grant Finance Officer (4264)
jobs.reason: Ineligible on two hard grounds: the role is based in Dakar with no London or remote-UK option (London-only filter), and it requires excellent written and verbal French, which exceeds the candidate's B1. It is also a finance/grant-management role requiring prior high-value multi-country budget management, well outside the candidate's research-and-writing profile.

jobs.title: Senior Transformation & Performance Manager, Springer Healthcare
jobs.reason: A "Senior Manager" role requiring a proven track record of business consulting, in-house transformation work and direct engagement with C-level stakeholders — well beyond entry-level and demanding several years of professional experience the candidate does not have. The subject matter (healthcare transformation, AI strategy) is also outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Research Associate, Science
jobs.reason: Not entry-level — it requires 5-9 years of research experience with 3-5 years of specialized survey research, well beyond the candidate's student-assistant background, so a hard experience disqualifier applies. It also demands specialized quantitative survey/polling expertise (regression, R) and sits outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Senior Content Producer - EXTEND
jobs.reason: This is a "Senior" role whose essential criteria require proven experience as a radio producer and strong audio craft skills, none of which the candidate has — a hard mismatch on both level and skills. It is also part of the BBC Extend programme restricted to disabled applicants, and the topic falls outside all three interest zones.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Adviser
jobs.reason: "Senior" title and a legal-adviser role that requires a legal qualification and substantial experience, neither of which the candidate holds. The accountability/international-law field is a perfect interest match, but level and qualification are hard mismatches.

jobs.title: Advisory Board Member
jobs.reason: An advisory board seat is a senior, expert-level appointment, not an entry-level paid role the candidate could take. Level is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: BHR Partnerships and Development Officer
jobs.reason: An "Officer"-level business-and-human-rights role in an international-law organisation is plausibly early-career and draws on the candidate's research, writing and stakeholder-coordination experience. Partnerships/development leans toward fundraising and comms, a partial gap, but the field is squarely on interest.

jobs.title: Internship - Speculative Opportunities
jobs.reason: An internship, and speculative at that, so excluded on both counts by policy regardless of the strong field match.

jobs.title: Legal Adviser
jobs.reason: A legal-adviser post requires a legal qualification the candidate does not hold (no qualifying law degree / GDL / SQE). The international-justice subject is a perfect match, but the qualification is an unmet essential.

jobs.title: OSINT Trainer and Safety Protocol Developer
jobs.reason: A "Trainer" and safety-protocol developer role presupposes established OSINT methodology and safety-protocol expertise to teach others, which the candidate does not have. This is a senior/specialist function, not an entry-level fit, despite the appealing OSINT/investigations angle.

jobs.title: Speculative Application
jobs.reason: A talent-pool / speculative posting with no concrete vacancy, excluded by policy. The organisation is on-mission, but there is no actual role to apply to.
